# vMLX 1.6.72

Naive N0.5 and GLM 5.3 Flash runtime and caching update.

- Naive N0.5: native reasoning/tool templates, JANGH loading, faster decode overlap, corrected output-memory accounting, and exact rotating-state SSD restoration.
- GLM 5.3 Flash: preserve native FP32 parameters; reuse MLA/DSA blocks with KDA checkpoints through tool and media turns; preserve sampled video frames by default with supported sampling and visual-token controls.
- API and chat: preserve tool arguments and reasoning history, retain logprob metadata for hidden parser markers, clean up canceled streams, and expose backend cache/prefill metrics through Ollama.
- Translate the measured-prefill counter consistently across supported UI languages.

Experimental kernel options remain opt-in. Performance depends on model, quantization, context and workload. This release does not claim universal MTP/prose speedups or elimination of model-generated arithmetic and scene-timing errors.
